notes.title: The demo is out!
notes.notes:
It's finally here!

This demo focuses on the Character Creator. Here you'll find a work-in-progress version of the customization options Desktop Pets will include in the final release.

[h2]In this demo you'll find[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fully working Character Creator
[*] The ability to use your own VRM 0.0 models
[*] Free of restrictions: create and spawn as many as you want
[*] Mod-friendly: unobfuscated code and my blessing to tinker with the game
[/list]

[h2]The full version will include[/h2]

[list]
[*] More clothing items
[*] More hairstyles
[*] Improved character AI
[*] More varied interaction options
[*] Full workshop support
[*] Free and premium characters with dialogue, dating and unlockables
[*] Possible collabs with other creators
[/list]
